Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN UPDATE dc SET [CustomerID] = sc.[CustomerID] ,[CompanyName] = sc.[CompanyName] ,[ContactName] = sc.[ContactName] ,[ContactTitle]= sc.[ContactTitle] ,[Address] = sc.[Address] ,[City] = sc.[City] ,[Region] = sc.[Region] ,[PostalCode] = sc.[PostalCode] ,[Country] = sc.[Country] ,[Phone] = sc.[Phone] ,[Fax] = sc.[Fax] FROM [dbo].[DimCustomer] dc INNER JOIN [staging].[customer] sc ON (dc.[CustomerKey] = sc.[CustomerKey]) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN UPDATE de SET [EmployeeID] = se.[EmployeeID] ,[LastName] = se.[LastName] ,[FirstName] = se.[FirstName] ,[FullName] = se.[FullName] ,[Title] = se.[Title] ,[TitleOfCourtesy] = se.[TitleOfCourtesy] ,[BirthDate] = se.[BirthDate] ,[HireDate] = se.[HireDate] ,[City] = se.[City] ,[Region] = se.[Region] ,[Country] = se.[Country] ,[ReportsTo] = se.[ReportsTo] ,[SupervisorName] = se.[SupervisorName] FROM [dbo].[DimEmployee] de INNER JOIN [staging].[employee] se ON (de.[EmployeeKey] = se.[EmployeeKey]) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN UPDATE dp SET [ProductID] = sp.[ProductID] ,[ProductName] = sp.[ProductName] ,[QuantityPerUnit] = sp.[QuantityPerUnit] ,[CurrentListPrice] = sp.[CurrentListPrice] ,[Discontinued] = sp.[Discontinued] ,[CategoryID] = sp.[CategoryID] ,[CategoryName] = sp.[CategoryName] ,[CategoryDescription]= sp.[CategoryDescription] ,[SupplierID] = sp.[SupplierID] ,[SupplierCompanyName]= sp.[SupplierCompanyName] ,[SupplierContactName]= sp.[SupplierContactName] ,[SupplierCity] = sp.[SupplierCity] ,[SupplierCountry] = sp.[SupplierCountry] FROM [dbo].[DimProduct] dp INNER JOIN [staging].[product] sp ON (dp.[ProductKey] = sp.[ProductKey]) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN UPDATE dsl SET [ShipCity] = ssl.[ShipCity] ,[ShipRegion] = ssl.[ShipRegion] ,[ShipCountry] = ssl.[ShipCountry] ,[ShipPostalCode]= ssl.[ShipPostalCode] FROM [dbo].[DimShipLocation] dsl INNER JOIN [staging].[shiplocation] ssl ON (dsl.[ShipLocationKey] = ssl.[ShipLocationKey]) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN UPDATE ds SET [ShipperID] = ss.[ShipperID] ,[CompanyName] = ss.[CompanyName] ,[Phone] = ss.[Phone] FROM [dbo].[DimShipper] ds INNER JOIN [staging].[shipper] ss ON (ds.[ShipperKey] = ss.[ShipperKey]) END

Property.Name: BodyScript
Property.Value: BEGIN UPDATE fs SET [OrderDateKey] = sfs.[OrderDateKey] ,[RequiredDateKey] = sfs.[RequiredDateKey] ,[ShippedDateKey] = sfs.[ShippedDateKey] ,[CustomerKey] = sfs.[CustomerKey] ,[ProductKey] = sfs.[ProductKey] ,[EmployeeKey] = sfs.[EmployeeKey] ,[ShipperKey] = sfs.[ShipperKey] ,[ShipLocationKey] = sfs.[ShipLocationKey] ,[UnitPrice] = sfs.[UnitPrice] ,[Quantity] = sfs.[Quantity] ,[Discount] = sfs.[Discount] ,[AllocatedFreight]= sfs.[AllocatedFreight] ,[DaysToShip] = sfs.[DaysToShip] ,[DaysLate] = sfs.[DaysLate] FROM [dbo].[Sales] fs INNER JOIN [staging].[sales] sfs ON (fs.[OrderID] = sfs.[OrderID] AND fs.[ProductKey] = sfs.[ProductKey]) END
